TagLib# (`TagLibSharp.dll`) is shipped unmodified as a separate dynamic library. You may replace it with your own
compatible build (LGPL section 6). The complete corresponding source code of the shipped version is available from the
repository linked above (tag `TaglibSharp-2.3.0.0`).
